title: Worship As Worldly Happiness First Aspect Needs Justice Sharia Prophethood And Belief

questions.question: What makes human beings different from other living things in the passage?
questions.answer: People are described as having a special and delicate nature that gives them choice, higher wishes, and a desire for a fitting life.

questions.question: What kinds of things do people naturally want according to the passage?
questions.answer: They want good and beautiful things, nice adornment, and a way of living that suits human dignity.

questions.question: Why can one person not prepare everything he needs by himself?
questions.answer: Because meeting human needs takes many different skills and jobs, and one person cannot do them all alone.

questions.question: What must people do because they cannot do every job themselves?
questions.answer: They need to live with others, help one another, and trade the results of their work.

questions.question: Which human powers are said to have no built-in limits?
questions.answer: Desire, anger, and intellect.

questions.question: What problem comes when these powers have no fixed limits?
questions.answer: People can go too far, become unfair, and harm others.

questions.question: Why does society need justice when people exchange their work?
questions.answer: Because without justice, people may cheat, oppress, or take more than is right.

questions.question: Why is one person’s mind not enough to fully establish justice for everyone?
questions.answer: Because a single person’s understanding is too limited to grasp complete justice for the whole community.

questions.question: What is the “universal intellect” described in the passage?
questions.answer: It is the law that guides justice for all people.

questions.question: What law is named as that universal law?
questions.answer: The Shari'a.

questions.question: Why is a prophet needed after a law is given?
questions.answer: A prophet is needed to bring the law, announce it, and make people accept its authority.

questions.question: What kind of qualities must a prophet have?
questions.answer: He must be above others in character, manners, appearance, spiritual rank, and moral strength.

questions.question: What shows that a prophet truly has a strong connection with Allah?
questions.answer: His miracles.

questions.question: Why do people need the greatness of the Creator kept alive in their minds?
questions.answer: So they will obey commands and stay away from what is forbidden.

questions.question: What helps keep belief strong and fresh in people’s minds?
questions.answer: A repeated reminder and renewed action, which is worship.

questions.question: What special gift in human nature allows people to make choices?
questions.answer: People have a unique nature that includes free choice.

questions.question: Besides choosing, what other human wishes are mentioned?
questions.answer: Wanting beauty, decoration, livelihood, and a respected place in life.

questions.question: Why do human needs lead to many arts and jobs?
questions.answer: Because food, clothing, and shelter must be prepared in skillful ways.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about working with others?
questions.answer: Human life depends on cooperation, mutual help, and sharing work.

questions.question: Why do human powers sometimes become dangerous?
questions.answer: Because they were not given tight natural limits, so they can go beyond what is right.

questions.question: What is one result of desire, anger, and intellect going beyond limits?
questions.answer: Oppression and harmful behavior appear among people.

questions.question: What does the community need in order to deal fairly with one another?
questions.answer: It needs justice.

questions.question: Why is a law greater than one person’s opinion needed?
questions.answer: Because justice for everyone must come from something broader and more reliable than one individual’s thinking.

questions.question: In the passage, what role does the Shari'a play?
questions.answer: It serves as the universal law that establishes justice.

questions.question: Why is someone needed to present and uphold that law?
questions.answer: Because a law needs a messenger and authority who declares it and leads people to follow it.

questions.question: Who is given that role in the passage?
questions.answer: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: Why must the Prophet be outstanding in both outer and inner ways?
questions.answer: So his leadership reaches people’s minds and hearts and continues strongly.

questions.question: What supports the truth of a prophet’s message?
questions.answer: Miracles that show Allah supports him.

questions.question: How are belief and obedience connected in the passage?
questions.answer: Strong belief in Allah’s greatness helps people follow commands and avoid wrong actions.

questions.question: What repeated practice keeps belief alive and settled in people?
questions.answer: Worship.

questions.question: What main idea begins the passage?
questions.answer: Human beings are created with a special nature unlike other creatures.

questions.question: How does this special nature affect human wants?
questions.answer: It gives people broad wishes, including choice, beauty, and a worthy way to live.

questions.question: What everyday needs are named as part of human life?
questions.answer: Food, clothing, and housing.

questions.question: Why do these needs push people toward society?
questions.answer: Because fulfilling them well requires many kinds of work, so people need one another.

questions.question: What three powers in people are discussed?
questions.answer: Appetite or desire, anger, and intellect.

questions.question: How are people different from animals in this matter?
questions.answer: Animals have more limited powers, while human powers are left open and can go too far.

questions.question: What social danger comes from those open-ended powers?
questions.answer: Injustice and aggression can spread among people.

questions.question: What protects society when people share goods and labor?
questions.answer: Justice protects society.

questions.question: Why can’t justice depend only on separate individuals?
questions.answer: Because individuals do not fully understand complete justice by themselves.

questions.question: What larger guide is needed for real justice?
questions.answer: A universal guiding law for everyone.

questions.question: What name does the passage give to that law?
questions.answer: The Shari'a.

questions.question: Why is a prophet necessary for this law?
questions.answer: Because the law needs someone to bring it, teach it, and enforce its authority.

questions.question: What kind of superiority should a prophet have?
questions.answer: He should be superior in body, spirit, morals, conduct, and character.

questions.question: What is the sign that a prophet’s link to the Lord is strong and true?
questions.answer: Miracles.

questions.question: Why must belief in Allah’s greatness be kept strong?
questions.answer: So people will follow what is commanded and stay away from what is forbidden.

questions.question: What repeated act serves as a constant reminder of belief?
questions.answer: Worship.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is unusual about human nature?
questions.answer: It is refined and unique, setting people apart from other living beings.

questions.question: What desires come from this unique nature?
questions.answer: The desire to choose, to seek beauty, and to have a proper living and place in life.

questions.question: Why is human life connected to many skills and professions?
questions.answer: Because basic needs must be prepared through many kinds of knowledge and work.

questions.question: What does this teach about being part of a community?
questions.answer: People are meant to cooperate, support one another, and exchange what they produce.

questions.question: Why does cooperation alone not solve every problem?
questions.answer: Because human desires and emotions can become excessive and lead to harm.

questions.question: Which part of human life makes justice necessary?
questions.answer: The exchange of labor and benefits among people.

questions.question: What does the passage say is too weak to fully define justice by itself?
questions.answer: The mind of any one individual.

questions.question: What must exist so all people can benefit from justice?
questions.answer: A general law that stands above individuals.

questions.question: What is that law identified as?
questions.answer: The Shari'a.

questions.question: Why does the law need a messenger and leader?
questions.answer: So it can be announced, claimed, and applied with authority.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the needed leader?
questions.answer: As the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: Why must a prophet influence both minds and hearts?
questions.answer: So his guidance remains strong outwardly and inwardly among people.

questions.question: What confirms that he speaks with authority from Allah?
questions.answer: The miracles given to him.

questions.question: Why are the truths of belief important for society’s obedience?
questions.answer: Because belief in Allah’s greatness makes people take commands seriously.

questions.question: What daily or repeated practice keeps those truths firm?
questions.answer: Worship keeps them firm.

questions.question: What first reason is given for the need for worship and guidance?
questions.answer: Human beings have a special nature with many desires and choices, which makes life complex.

questions.question: What human needs are mentioned as requiring effort and skill?
questions.answer: Eating, dressing, and having a place to live.

questions.question: Why do these needs make people depend on each other?
questions.answer: Because many crafts are needed, and no one can master all of them alone.

questions.question: What kind of social behavior is encouraged because of this dependence?
questions.answer: Cooperation, mutual aid, and exchange.

questions.question: Why do problems still appear among people even though they need each other?
questions.answer: Because human desire, anger, and intellect can exceed proper limits.

questions.question: What happens when these powers exceed their limits?
questions.answer: People may act unjustly and become aggressive.

questions.question: What is needed to keep people fair in their dealings?
questions.answer: Justice is needed.

questions.question: Why can justice not rest only on personal opinions?
questions.answer: Because one person’s understanding is too small and limited.

questions.question: What does the passage present as the fair guide for everyone?
questions.answer: A universal law.

questions.question: What is that universal law called here?
questions.answer: The Shari'a.

questions.question: Why is the existence of a prophet tied to the law?
questions.answer: Because the law needs someone to deliver it and establish its authority.

questions.question: What must people see in a prophet so they can trust and follow him?
questions.answer: Excellence in character, conduct, moral strength, and spiritual and outward qualities.

questions.question: What special evidence supports a prophet’s mission?
questions.answer: Miracles.

questions.question: What must be planted in people’s hearts so they obey and avoid sin?
questions.answer: A strong sense of Allah’s greatness and sovereignty.

questions.question: What practice renews that sense again and again?
questions.answer: Worship.

questions.question: How are humans set apart from other creatures in the passage?
questions.answer: They are given a special nature with deeper choices, wants, and aims.

questions.question: What kinds of aims are included in human nature?
questions.answer: Seeking beautiful things, adornment, provision, and a suitable rank in life.

questions.question: Why are many occupations necessary for human life?
questions.answer: Because human needs are many and must be prepared skillfully.

questions.question: What does the passage say people must do with one another?
questions.answer: They must join together, help each other, and share the products of their work.

questions.question: What are the three human powers named in the passage?
questions.answer: Appetite, anger, and intellect.

questions.question: Why do these powers create a need for rules?
questions.answer: Because without natural limits they may lead to excess, wrongdoing, and oppression.

questions.question: What moral need rises in society because of this danger?
questions.answer: The need for justice.

questions.question: Why is a common, larger guide needed for justice?
questions.answer: Because individual minds alone cannot fully understand and apply justice for all.

questions.question: What serves as that common guide?
questions.answer: The universal law.

questions.question: What is this law called in the passage?
questions.answer: The Shari'a.

questions.question: Why must there be a prophet along with the law?
questions.answer: Because the law needs a trusted messenger, teacher, and enforcer.

questions.question: What qualities help a prophet guide people successfully?
questions.answer: Great moral beauty, strong character, spiritual excellence, and noble conduct.

questions.question: What proof makes his connection to Allah clear?
questions.answer: Miracles.

questions.question: How does belief support following Allah’s commands?
questions.answer: Belief keeps the greatness of the Creator alive in people, which moves them to obey.

questions.question: What is the ongoing reminder that keeps belief firm?
questions.answer: Worship.
